name: tech-large-corpus-v1
comment: A marker-free, bilingual technical corpus. Stable keys are metadata only and never appear in note titles or bodies.

notes.title: Account recovery window
notes.body:
Support can issue a password reset link after verifying the owner.
The link becomes invalid after fifteen minutes, even when it has not been opened.
Completing the reset signs the account out on every device.

notes.title: Removing access from a stolen laptop
notes.body:
Open the trusted-device list from another machine.
Deleting the missing device invalidates every active session associated with it.
Create a fresh pairing code only after the old access has been removed.

notes.title: 控制台导航
notes.body:
普通成员只能查看自己的工作区。
管理员可以从头像菜单里的服务入口打开控制台。
移动端把同一项放在底部菜单中。

notes.title: Quarter-end finance calendar
notes.body:
Late supplier invoices stop being accepted on Friday.
External accountants receive the summary reports the following morning.
The books are locked on the second business day.

notes.title: 办公区访客动线
notes.body:
访客先在东门前台登记。
员工刷卡通道不接待快递人员。
夜间到访需要值班同事下楼接应。

notes.title: 机房疏散说明
notes.body:
听到连续警报后不要乘坐电梯。
安全出口位于机柜区西侧的防火门后。
所有人到停车场北侧集合点清点人数。

notes.title: Stopping an inconclusive experiment
notes.body:
The owner may end a test early when the guardrail metric regresses.
Record the stopping reason before disabling the treatment.
Do not interpret a truncated run as a statistically complete result.

notes.title: 应用偏好面板
notes.body:
个人选项不会跟随共享工作区同步。
设置页面从搜索框右侧的滑杆图标打开。
主题和卡片宽度修改后立即生效。

notes.title: Camera profile checklist
notes.body:
Save one exposure preset for indoor interviews.
Keep automatic white balance off under mixed lighting.
Reset the profile before the camera is returned.

notes.title: 新设备可信校验
notes.body:
首次连接时由已经登录的终端确认申请。
设备认证依赖一次性挑战值和本机保存的私钥。
服务端只记录公钥指纹与授权时间。

notes.title: Museum visitor badge review
notes.body:
The front desk compares each reservation with a photo document.
Temporary badges use a different color from employee passes.
Unreturned badges are disabled automatically after closing time.

notes.title: 图片传输限制
notes.body:
客户端会先生成缩略图再发送原图。
单张图片超过十二兆字节时上传会被拒绝。
失败的临时对象会在当天夜间清理。

notes.title: Research archive ingestion
notes.body:
Large microscope recordings arrive through an offline transfer station.
The archive verifies a checksum before accepting each object.
Corrupt source media is returned to the laboratory.

notes.title: API credential rotation
notes.body:
Create the replacement secret while the old credential is still valid.
Run both keys in parallel for one deployment, then revoke the earlier one.
Audit logs should identify which generation signed each request.

notes.title: 通行密钥恢复策略
notes.body:
注册第二枚硬件密钥可以避免单点丢失。
没有可用密钥时，备用验证码只能使用一次。
恢复完成后系统要求重新登记生物识别信息。

notes.title: Browser request forgery defense
notes.body:
State-changing requests require a token bound to the current session.
Cookies use SameSite=Lax as a second layer rather than the only defense.
A failed origin check is logged without retaining the submitted form.

notes.title: 回调消息验签
notes.body:
发送方用共享密钥对时间戳和原始请求体计算摘要。
接收端必须在解析 JSON 之前验证签名。
超过五分钟的消息即使摘要正确也会拒绝。

notes.title: Repository secret scanning
notes.body:
Every push is inspected for high-entropy credentials and known token formats.
A confirmed leak blocks the merge and opens a rotation checklist.
Test fixtures are allow-listed by exact fingerprint, never by directory.

notes.title: 服务账号权限边界
notes.body:
图片处理任务只能读取输入对象并写入派生目录。
生产服务账号不具备创建新存储桶的权限。
临时排障授权会在两小时后自动收回。

notes.title: Encryption key custody review
notes.body:
The application encrypts private exports before they leave the worker.
Production and staging use separate key rings.
A key identifier is stored beside each encrypted object.
Operators cannot download raw master material.
Access to the recovery console requires two people.
Quarterly drills decrypt a synthetic backup.
Every unwrap operation produces an immutable audit event.
Old material remains available while retained backups still reference it.
If a custodian leaves the company, remove that person before issuing a new generation.
Destroy retired material only after the final dependent archive expires.

notes.title: Database recovery rehearsal
notes.body:
Copy the weekly snapshot into an isolated account.
Restore the dump into a scratch database and compare row totals.
The exercise is complete only after the application reads a sampled note.

notes.title: 只读副本延迟处理
notes.body:
详情页优先读取主库以避免刚写入的数据消失。
副本落后超过五秒时，报表请求会显示数据时间戳。
监控连续三次超限才通知值班人员。

notes.title: Changing a populated table safely
notes.body:
Add the nullable column before releasing code that writes it.
Backfill old rows in bounded batches and pause when replica delay rises.
Make the field mandatory only after every reader understands it.

notes.title: 在线表结构变更
notes.body:
先创建影子表并持续复制增量写入。
校验行数和校验和一致后再短暂切换表名。
旧表保留一天用于快速回退。

notes.title: Index maintenance signals
notes.body:
A growing heap-to-index ratio indicates wasted pages after heavy churn.
Schedule a concurrent rebuild when scans become slower despite stable traffic.
Do not compact during the reporting peak.

notes.title: 慢查询执行计划
notes.body:
先确认过滤条件是否在扫描节点之前生效。
如果估算行数偏差很大，就刷新表统计信息。
临时加索引前必须记录基线耗时。

notes.title: Connection pool sizing
notes.body:
Reserve several database connections for migrations and operator access.
Workers wait briefly for a slot instead of opening unbounded sockets.
Pool pressure is measured by checkout time, not only active count.

notes.title: 重复请求防护
notes.body:
客户端为每次支付动作生成随机请求标识。
服务端在同一标识再次出现时返回之前的结果。
去重记录的保留时间必须长于客户端重试窗口。

notes.title: Choosing transaction isolation
notes.body:
Inventory reservation runs in a serializable transaction to prevent overselling.
Read-only dashboards tolerate a consistent snapshot.
Retries include jitter because serialization failures are expected under contention.

notes.title: 日志保留规则
notes.body:
普通请求日志保存十四天后自动删除。
安全审计事件单独保存一年并禁止业务人员修改。
用户主动删除账号时会立即清除关联调试样本。

notes.title: Cold record archiving
notes.body:
Completed jobs older than six months move to compressed object storage.
The primary database keeps a small lookup stub for support requests.
A restore job rehydrates one tenant at a time.

notes.title: 租户行级隔离
notes.body:
数据库策略从会话变量读取当前租户标识。
没有租户上下文的查询默认看不到任何业务行。
后台任务必须逐个租户建立独立事务。

notes.title: Time partition query rules
notes.body:
Reports must include a bounded event timestamp predicate.
The planner can skip monthly partitions only when the boundary is explicit.
An unbounded export is sent to the asynchronous job queue.

notes.title: 变更数据捕获
notes.body:
连接器从数据库日志中读取已经提交的修改。
每个下游消费者独立保存最后确认的偏移量。
表结构事件必须先于使用新字段的数据发送。

notes.title: Redis memory policy
notes.body:
Session records use a dedicated instance where eviction is disabled.
The general cache removes the least recently used expiring key first.
Memory alerts fire before the allocator reaches its hard limit.

notes.title: 热点缓存失效保护
notes.body:
过期前由一个请求取得刷新锁，其他请求继续读取旧值。
锁持有者失败时，短随机延迟可以避免同时回源。
空结果也会缓存几十秒。

notes.title: Vector schema compatibility
notes.body:
The index dimension is fixed when the collection is created.
Changing embedding models requires a new collection when vector widths differ.
Dual writing keeps search available during the rebuild.

notes.title: 向量检索范围过滤
notes.body:
查询向量前先限定当前用户和未删除状态。
过滤条件缺失会让其他租户的候选进入排序阶段。
索引元数据只保存匿名内部标识。

notes.title: Object lifecycle policy
notes.body:
Incomplete multipart transfers are removed after one day.
Unreferenced previews enter a seven-day quarantine before deletion.
Legal-hold objects are excluded from every automatic expiration rule.

notes.title: 私有图片访问链路
notes.body:
原始图片只保存在不公开的对象桶中。
数据库记录对象键而不是完整网址。
读取请求先验证笔记所属用户。
边缘函数为通过校验的对象生成临时地址。
临时地址绑定请求方法。
响应要求浏览器不要长期缓存。
缩略图使用独立的尺寸白名单。
外链失效不影响对象本身。
泄露签名密钥后必须立即轮换并缩短所有现存链接的有效期。
访问日志只保留匿名设备散列。

notes.title: Terraform change review
notes.body:
Initialize providers from the checked-in lock file.
Run terraform plan -out=release.tfplan to preview production changes.
A second engineer reviews the saved plan before apply.

notes.title: 工作负载快速回退
notes.body:
先暂停继续发布，避免新副本覆盖历史记录。
执行 kubectl rollout undo deployment/notes-api 恢复上一版本。
完成后检查就绪副本和错误率。

notes.title: Helm template verification
notes.body:
Render values for the target namespace before contacting the cluster.
Use helm upgrade notes ./chart --dry-run --debug to inspect generated resources.
Secrets in command output must be redacted from CI logs.

notes.title: 远端数据库升级命令
notes.body:
本地演练使用临时数据库。
生产变更执行 wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote。
应用新版本前确认迁移记录已经落库。

notes.title: Container memory termination
notes.body:
Status 137 usually means the process exceeded its memory allowance.
Compare the working set with the configured cgroup limit.
Raise the limit only after checking for an unbounded cache.

notes.title: 请求驱动的弹性伸缩
notes.body:
副本数根据排队时长而不是 CPU 单独决定。
扩容冷却期设置为一分钟，缩容需要连续十分钟空闲。
至少保留两个实例跨故障域运行。

notes.title: Blue-green release procedure
notes.body:
Deploy the candidate into the idle environment without changing traffic.
Warm caches and run smoke checks before switching the router.
Keep the former environment intact until the observation window closes.

notes.title: 小流量发布策略
notes.body:
新版本先接收百分之一的真实请求。
每五分钟比较错误率和延迟，再逐步扩大比例。
任何核心指标越界都会自动停止放量。

notes.title: DNS cutover timing
notes.body:
Lower the record lifetime a full day before moving the service.
Wait for old resolver caches to age out before changing the address.
Restore a longer value after traffic has stabilized.

notes.title: 证书自动续期
notes.body:
到期前二十一天由定时任务申请新证书。
部署完成后从外部探针检查证书链和剩余时间。
连续两次续期失败才升级到人工告警。

notes.title: Deploying without dropped requests
notes.body:
Stop routing new traffic before terminating an old instance.
Allow in-flight requests to finish during the drain period.
Start replacement capacity before the shutdown sequence begins.

notes.title: 功能开关治理
notes.body:
高风险能力默认关闭，并按租户逐步启用。
每个开关都要登记负责人和预定删除日期。
紧急关闭不依赖重新构建客户端。

notes.title: Build artifact provenance
notes.body:
The release bundle is signed by the isolated CI identity.
An attestation records the source revision and exact build workflow.
Deployment rejects artifacts whose signature or provenance cannot be verified.

notes.title: 构建缓存命中策略
notes.body:
依赖缓存的键包含锁文件摘要和运行时版本。
编译产物只在完整提交哈希一致时复用。
缓存损坏后任务会自动清空并重试一次。

notes.title: Selective monorepo checks
notes.body:
Compute the changed package graph from the merge base.
Test every modified project plus consumers that depend on its public API.
A shared build-tool change intentionally invalidates the entire graph.

notes.title: 不稳定测试处置
notes.body:
偶发失败的用例先自动重跑一次并记录两次日志。
连续一周出现三次后转入隔离队列且指定负责人。
隔离不能降低主分支的必需覆盖率。

notes.title: Rollback decision signal
notes.body:
Use customer-visible error rate as the primary release guardrail.
A brief CPU spike alone does not justify reverting a healthy build.
The on-call lead records the metric window used for the decision.

notes.title: 定时任务错峰
notes.body:
清理任务安排在整点后的第十七分钟。
同一账户的任务用租约避免多个实例重复执行。
运行超过四分钟会记录超时并交给下一轮继续。

notes.title: Dead-letter queue operations
notes.body:
Messages move aside after five failed deliveries.
Operators inspect a redacted payload and the final error before replay.
Reprocessing preserves the original idempotency identifier.

notes.title: 异步消息可靠性手册
notes.body:
生产者先在数据库事务中写入待发送记录。
转发器按创建时间批量读取。
每条消息携带全局唯一标识。
消费者在处理前查询去重表。
已经成功的标识再次到达时直接确认，不重复执行业务动作。
处理结果和去重记录写入同一事务。
暂时错误使用指数退避。
永久错误进入人工队列。
消息体不得包含明文访问令牌。
积压超过十分钟触发容量告警。

notes.title: Distributed trace continuity
notes.body:
Pass the trace context header through every internal HTTP request.
A queue producer stores the parent span identifier in message metadata.
Background consumers start a linked span rather than an unrelated trace.

notes.title: 延迟分位数看板
notes.body:
平均值无法反映少量非常慢的请求。
主看板展示第五十、九十五和九十九分位。
发布比较使用相同流量窗口避免误判。

notes.title: SLO burn-rate alerting
notes.body:
A fast window catches outages that consume the budget rapidly.
A slower window confirms the condition before paging an engineer.
Ticket-only alerts cover gradual consumption that is not urgent.

notes.title: 告警分流规则
notes.body:
支付失败通知主值班，文档构建失败只发团队频道。
同一根因产生的重复事件会在十分钟内合并。
没有负责人标签的高优先级告警进入平台团队。

notes.title: Sensitive log redaction
notes.body:
Structured logging masks credential-bearing headers before serialization.
Email addresses are replaced with a stable one-way digest for correlation.
The raw request body is omitted from production error events.

notes.title: 链路采样规则
notes.body:
正常请求只保留百分之一的完整轨迹。
发生服务端错误时强制保存对应链路。
采样决定由入口服务生成并向下游传递。

notes.title: Metric label cardinality
notes.body:
Never use note identifiers or raw paths as metric labels.
Bounded route templates keep the time-series count predictable.
High-cardinality detail belongs in traces or sampled logs.

notes.title: 消费者背压
notes.body:
处理延迟上升时先减少拉取批次而不是继续堆内存。
队列客户端根据未完成任务数暂停读取。
恢复速度需要逐级增加，避免再次压垮数据库。

notes.title: Circuit breaker behavior
notes.body:
Open the breaker after a sustained run of upstream failures.
Allow a small number of probes during the half-open state.
Cached data may be served with an explicit stale marker.

notes.title: 存活与就绪探针
notes.body:
存活检查只判断进程是否还能继续工作。
就绪检查同时确认关键依赖可用，否则实例退出流量。
启动探针为首次加载模型预留更长时间。

notes.title: Clock skew safeguards
notes.body:
Reject signed requests whose timestamp differs by more than five minutes.
Hosts synchronize against multiple independent time sources.
Monitoring compares wall-clock drift without exposing client timestamps.

notes.title: 事故时间线记录
notes.body:
所有时间统一使用协调世界时并保留原始日志链接。
先记录观察到的事实，再补充推测和决策原因。
恢复服务后由未参与处置的人校对顺序。

notes.title: Blameless incident review
notes.body:
Describe the conditions that made an action reasonable at the time.
Assign follow-ups to system weaknesses rather than individual mistakes.
Every action item receives an owner and a due date.

notes.title: 容量预估方法
notes.body:
用过去八周峰值再加三成余量规划常态容量。
大促前单独压测数据库写入和对象存储带宽。
扩容交付时间必须计入告警阈值。

notes.title: Disk saturation diagnosis
notes.body:
A full I/O queue can raise latency before disk space runs out.
Compare utilization with await time and write amplification.
Move compaction away from peak ingestion hours.

notes.title: 陈旧向量排查
notes.body:
数据库行已更新但索引版本没变化时，搜索可能返回旧内容。
按内容摘要对比当前分块和向量元数据。
确认差异后只重新排队受影响的笔记。

notes.title: Orphaned object cleanup
notes.body:
List storage keys in bounded pages and compare them with live references.
Move unmatched objects into quarantine instead of deleting immediately.
A second sweep removes only items that remain unreferenced after seven days.

notes.title: 健康接口约定
notes.body:
基础探针只返回状态和构建版本，不查询用户数据。
依赖异常时响应五零三并标明匿名组件名称。
接口不得泄露数据库地址或环境变量。

notes.title: Reducing cold-start delay
notes.body:
Keep initialization free of network calls that can wait until the first feature use.
Load optional search resources lazily after the shell is interactive.
Track startup separately from request execution time.

notes.title: 边缘服务区域故障手册
notes.body:
首先确认问题是否只发生在单一运营商。
比较不同区域的健康探针结果。
检查最近的路由规则变更。
暂停所有非必要发布。
保持已经建立的长连接继续服务。
新请求临时引导到相邻区域。
跨区写入仍由主区域串行处理。
不要在网络分区期间同时提升两个写入主节点。
恢复后核对各区域事件偏移量。
如果发现重复写入，依据幂等标识保留首次成功结果。
逐步恢复流量并观察错误预算。
事故结束后撤销临时路由。

notes.title: Exact search before semantic search
notes.body:
Run normalized character matching first because it is immediate and deterministic.
Only invoke the semantic path when exact matching returns no notes.
Creation remains the first row regardless of search mode.

notes.title: 语义检索回退
notes.body:
字符搜索为空后才请求查询向量。
候选必须同时通过绝对阈值和相对分数门槛。
模型失败时返回空结果而不是阻塞快速创建。

notes.title: Cross-encoder reranking notes
notes.body:
A reranker reads the original query together with each candidate passage.
Its score may reorder results even when embedding similarity preferred another note.
Apply a calibrated cutoff after scoring all supplied candidates.

notes.title: 短查询扩展实验
notes.body:
只对词数很少且首轮为空的查询生成第二视角。
原始视角和扩展视角必须命中同一分块才允许救回。
扩展文本不得写入用户数据或索引。

notes.title: Embedding document formatting
notes.body:
Pass the actual note title through the model's dedicated title field.
Keep the body in the text field instead of pretending the title is absent.
Changing this template requires a versioned full reindex.

notes.title: 分块窗口设计
notes.body:
逻辑行很短时把相邻三行合成一个检索窗口。
窗口之间保留一行重叠，避免答案落在边界外。
返回前再把窗口收窄到最相关的完整句子。

notes.title: Stable line anchors
notes.body:
Store both the logical line number and source character offsets with every chunk.
Wrapped visual rows still point back to one body line.
Editing the note regenerates anchors in a single transaction.

notes.title: 混合排序规则
notes.body:
精准字符结果始终排在语义候选之前。
同一笔记的多个语义命中按最高分聚合。
分数相同时优先最近编辑的笔记。

notes.title: False-positive review
notes.body:
Inspect the strongest irrelevant passage for every failed query.
Threshold selection must consider competing notes, not only easy unanswerable prompts.
A lower cutoff is rejected when it admits semantically adjacent noise.

notes.title: 跨语言短词评测
notes.body:
裸词允许目标进入前三，带上下文的表达必须排第一。
英文到中文和中文到英文需要分别统计。
多义词负例用于约束扩展策略的噪声。

notes.title: Prompt injection in retrieved notes
notes.body:
Treat note text as untrusted data rather than model instructions.
The search pipeline never grants tools based on retrieved content.
Diagnostics escape control characters before rendering snippets.

notes.title: 模型调用成本控制
notes.body:
相同内容摘要对应的文档向量可以长期复用。
查询向量只做短时间缓存，避免记录完整搜索历史。
批量生成向量能减少网络往返。

notes.title: Batch embedding throughput
notes.body:
Group documents up to the provider's token and item limits.
Separate oversized passages so one failure does not reject the whole queue.
Record item-level retries with stable mutation identifiers.

notes.title: 生成式回答约束
notes.body:
只有检索结果明确包含答案时才生成摘要。
引用必须指向实际笔记和对应行。
证据不足时直接说明没有找到。

notes.title: Frozen evaluation discipline
notes.body:
Choose models and thresholds only on the calibration split.
Run the untouched holdout once after implementation choices are fixed.
A failed holdout leads to a new version, never silent retuning.

notes.title: 评测数据泄漏审计
notes.body:
稳定键只允许出现在本地元数据中。
写入评测笔记前先移除标题标记。
索引文档不能包含答案标签。
查询集合与语料生成模板分开维护。
校准集可以反复运行。
冻结集不得参与模型选择。
报告必须记录实际候选深度。
缺少任一查询时整次评测标记为不完整。
如果英文键被拼进中文标题，跨语言得分会被虚假抬高。
清理任务根据服务端变更标识删除测试数据。

notes.title: Search-first note capture
notes.body:
Opening the app places the caret in the single search box.
The first result offers to create a note from the typed title.
There are no folders or nested notebooks.

notes.title: 键盘结果导航
notes.body:
向下键选择下一条命中，向上键返回上一条。
回车在同一笔记内跳到下一个匹配行。
选中状态只显示细边框，不改变卡片尺寸。

notes.title: Copy and edit shortcut
notes.body:
Pressing Tab copies the currently highlighted logical line.
The same action focuses the line for immediate editing.
Clipboard failure does not prevent the editor from opening.

notes.title: 手机端安装方式
notes.body:
在浏览器分享菜单中选择添加到主屏幕。
启动图标打开独立窗口但仍由网页更新。
手机端不需要应用商店账号。

notes.title: Autosave behavior
notes.body:
Persist text after a short idle interval rather than showing a save button.
Flush pending edits when focus leaves the note or the window closes.
A small status dot indicates retry without shifting the layout.

notes.title: 图片粘贴交互
notes.body:
剪贴板里包含图片时直接插入当前光标所在行。
上传期间显示本地预览并保留文字输入。
失败后在原位置提供轻量重试提示。

notes.title: Swipe-to-delete interaction
notes.body:
Dragging a card left reveals one destructive icon without moving neighboring cards.
Releasing before the threshold returns the card to rest.
Deletion opens an in-app confirmation sheet instead of a browser dialog.

notes.title: 自定义确认弹层
notes.body:
弹层说明将要删除的笔记且默认聚焦取消。
确认按钮使用危险色但不会抢占键盘焦点。
按 Escape 或点击遮罩都能安全关闭。

notes.title: Stacked card motion
notes.body:
Only the immediately previous card remains visible behind the active one.
Wrapping from the final result to the first resets the stack with a continuous transition.
Hidden cards do not accumulate individual shadows.

notes.title: 编辑时避免页面抖动
notes.body:
聚焦正文不会改变字号、内边距或图片尺寸。
删除按钮预留固定空间，出现时不推动内容。
光标进入卡片后保持当前滚动位置。

notes.title: Wide reading layout
notes.body:
A preference lets cards use most of the available desktop width.
The search header follows the same width constraint as the note stream.
Mobile keeps a fixed safe margin for touch gestures.

notes.title: 命中行视觉反馈
notes.body:
当前结果使用细腻的彩虹荧光底纹。
切换匹配时高光快速滑到新的文字范围。
动画只改变绘制效果，不触发布局重排。

notes.title: IME composition handling
notes.body:
Ignore Enter while the browser reports an active text composition.
Creating a note waits for the compositionend event to finish.
Arrow keys remain owned by the input method during candidate selection.

notes.title: 离线应用外壳
notes.body:
服务工作线程缓存启动所需的静态资源。
未联网时展示只读状态而不是空白页面。
重新连接后再从服务端拉取最新笔记。

notes.title: Optimistic note updates
notes.body:
Apply edits locally before the network response returns.
Attach a version number so the server can reject stale writes.
A failed request remains visible with a retry state.

notes.title: 多人编辑冲突处理
notes.body:
服务端发现版本落后时返回最新正文和冲突标记。
客户端保留本地草稿，不直接覆盖远端修改。
用户可以逐行选择保留哪一侧内容。

notes.title: API contract verification
notes.body:
Consumer tests pin required response fields without freezing irrelevant ordering.
The provider runs every published contract before deployment.
Breaking changes require a new endpoint version.

notes.title: 数据库升级回归测试
notes.body:
每个迁移都从上一个发布版本的快照开始执行。
测试同时验证向前升级和允许的回滚路径。
数据量边界使用接近生产规模的合成记录。

notes.title: Search load test
notes.body:
Replay a realistic mix of exact hits, misses, and semantic fallbacks.
Measure tail latency while indexing jobs run in the background.
Rate limits are tested per user rather than from one global client.

notes.title: 队列故障演练
notes.body:
随机让少量消费者在确认前退出。
验证消息最终完成且业务副作用只发生一次。
演练结束后自动清理注入的测试标记。

notes.title: Focused test command
notes.body:
Run pnpm test --filter semantic-search while iterating on ranking logic.
Use the full test suite before opening a release pull request.
Type checking runs as a separate required job.

notes.title: 前端错误定位
notes.body:
生产构建上传源码映射但不向公开客户端提供。
错误平台使用发布版本号还原压缩后的调用栈。
上传失败会阻止对应版本进入正式环境。

notes.title: Keyboard accessibility audit
notes.body:
Every interactive control is reachable in a logical tab order.
Focus indicators remain visible at high zoom and in forced-color mode.
Card gestures always have an equivalent button action.

notes.title: 隐私安全诊断接口
notes.body:
诊断请求必须携带高熵运维令牌。
响应只返回匿名分数和聚合数量。
笔记标题、正文、图片地址和内部标识都不得输出。
